disposition: Real behavior exists for all four operations (backup, restore, smuggler export/import, manifest-verified V1-to-V2 logical migration) with focused passing tests, but the contract's clause on which credentials/authorization checks reject or skip records has no behavior (local-filesystem only, no credentials anywhere), and the migration reads a synthetic V1 representation rather than real V1 exporter output; the contract facts themselves record that no recovery proof is claimed by this inventory row.
